title: Star-studded Rams stunned by Brock Purdy and 49ers in Australian season opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Star-studded Rams stunned by Brock Purdy and 49ers in Australian season opener
sources.description: The Rams entered the 2026 season as the favorite to win the Super Bowl, but Brock Purdy and the San Francisco 49ers dominate them in a 27-7 win.
